unresolved_field_audit.why: The run reached 'complete', so an empty unresolved list is truthful for THIS artifact. The defect was latent, not realised.
unresolved_field_audit.defect: k1814.py ablation loop called checkpoint(f'ablation:{name}', []) on every iteration, so any artifact cut mid-ablation-loop would have declared zero unresolved items while holding only 1-4 of 5 ablations. The robustness loop did this correctly. This is exactly the failure mode the 2026-07-30 06:08 inventory observed live (1/5 ablations done, unresolved=[]).
unresolved_field_audit.fix: ablation loop now tracks pending_ablations and reports ['ablation not yet run: <spec>', ...] for every spec not yet completed.
unresolved_field_audit.rerun_rationale: Fix changes only what a FUTURE partial artifact reports. It touches no estimation, no data, no verdict logic. The archived numbers are unaffected.
